subject: Integrated SDLC evidence: secrets, CI rollbacks & approval trails
messages:
From: Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@assessors-inc.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: security@brightline.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integrated SDLC evidence request: secrets, CI rollbacks & approval trails

Hi Michael,

We're preparing Brightline's SIG assessment and need a compact package showing how Redwood handles secret lifecycle, CI/CD approval gates, and rollback tracking for production releases. Can you provide the following artifacts or a secure bundle we can download? Prefer within 5 business days if possible.

Requested items (short):
- A short code-review sample (redacted), with PR approval timestamps and reviewer IDs.
- CI/CD pipeline snippets that demonstrate enforced approval gates (merge checks, required approvers).
- Evidence of ephemeral secret issuance and rotation (audit logs or sampling CSV) — show at least one rotation event.
- A concise rollback chronology from one recent incident (steps taken, authorizations, timestamps).
- A short attestation note signed by your security/engineering lead stating these artifacts are representative.

Also let us know if any of the artifacts need redaction or an NDA before delivery. If you can provide a secure Drive link or S3 expiring URL that works.

Thanks,
Elaine
Elaine Kim
Assessors Inc.
elaine.kim@assessors-inc.com

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@assessors-inc.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 10:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integrated SDLC evidence request: secrets, CI rollbacks & approval trails

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear checklist. We can deliver a focused package that answers each bullet. High-level plan:

1) Code review sample: we'll extract a representative PR thread with approvals and timestamped reviewer comments, redacting any PII or sensitive tokens.
2) CI/CD snippet: provide the pipeline YAML for our protected merge pipeline that enforces required reviewers and a manual approval job for production deploys.
3) Secrets rotation sample: an export (CSV) of ephemeral key rotations for a non-prod key rotation during the requested period (no cleartext secrets included).
4) Rollback chronology: condensed timeline (CSV) and a short narrative describing rollback decision, approvers, and remediation steps.
5) Attestation: short signed note from me and CC to our Security lead (Irene).

We will place artifacts in a secure Drive folder and share an expiring link. Lauren, can you coordinate extraction and redaction and confirm any items that need minimal PR-level redaction? Irene, will you draft the attestation once the artifacts are ready? Marissa, FYI for any CS/internal questions from Brightline.

Timeline: initial bundle by EOD Friday (2028-06-25) — if we need more time we'll flag by Thursday.

Michael Grant
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

Need minor collection work (complete by Thursday):
